en.headline: Health authorities urge completion of free HPV catch-up before year end
en.dek: The one-off programme for females born between 2004 and 2008 ends on 31 December, after more than 74,000 doses have been administered.
body: The Centre for Health Protection of the Department of Health reminded the public on Thursday that the government’s one-off Human Papillomavirus Vaccination Catch-up Programme will conclude on 31 December 2026.

Controller of the Centre for Health Protection Dr Edwin Tsui said the programme had been running for nearly two years and more than 74,000 vaccine doses had been given. Eligible female Hong Kong residents born between 2004 and 2008 who received a first dose should contact Women Wellness Satellites or designated District Health Centres as soon as possible to finish the series, or they would have to arrange and pay for vaccination themselves afterwards.

Under the programme, women with normal immune function receive two free doses at least five months apart, while immunocompromised persons receive three free doses. The centre noted that HPV vaccines protect against high-risk types responsible for most cervical cancers, and that coverage among 15-year-old girls under the school programme has already exceeded 90 per cent.

Dr Tsui also addressed common misconceptions, stating that HPV infection is not limited to people with multiple partners and that the vaccines have a long safety record confirmed by the World Health Organization. He urged eligible residents to complete the free course before the deadline.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心籲合資格女性於年底前完成HPV疫苗免費補種
zh.dek: 為2004至2008年出生女性而設的一次性補種計劃將於12月31日結束，至今已接種超過74,000劑。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心周四提醒市民，政府自2024年推出的一次性人類乳頭瘤病毒疫苗補種計劃將於2026年12月31日完結。
中心總監徐樂堅表示，計劃推出近兩年，累計接種超過74,000劑。已在計劃下接種第一劑的合資格女性香港居民（2004至2008年出生）應盡快聯絡樂妍站或指定地區康健中心完成餘下劑次，否則日後需自行安排及自費接種。
計劃下免疫功能正常的女性可免費接種兩劑，建議相隔至少五個月；免疫力較弱人士則可免費接種三劑。中心指出，HPV疫苗可預防引致大多數子宮頸癌的高危型病毒，而小學女童兩劑完成率已超過九成。
徐樂堅亦澄清常見誤解，指感染HPV並非只限於有多名性伴侶的人士，疫苗安全性已獲世界衞生組織確認。他呼籲合資格人士把握最後機會完成免費接種。
